mapper.select: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS pp.name AS place_name, pp.partnership_fl, pp.category_cd AS category_cd, pp.category_group_name, pp.category_name AS category_name, pp.status, pp.tel AS phone, pp.full_address AS address_name, pp.road_address AS road_address_name, pp.x_position AS x, pp.y_position AS y, pp.place_url, pp.description, (SELECT bf_fileurl FROM g5_board_file gbf INNER JOIN pet_place_file_mapping ppfm ON gbf.bo_table = 'pet_place' AND gbf.wr_id = ppfm.pfm_id WHERE ppfm.place_id = pp.id LIMIT 1) AS image_url, pp.opening_hours, IFNULL((SELECT CAST(AVG(point) AS signed integer) FROM pet_review WHERE place_id = pp.id), 0) AS point FROM pet_place pp WHERE pp.del_fl = 0 AND pp.id = #{placeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_place ( name, category_cd, category_group_name, category_name, status, tel, full_address, road_address, x_position, y_position, place_url, thumbnail_url ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{categoryCd}, #{categoryGroupName}, #{categoryName}, #{status}, #{tel}, #{fullAddress}, #{roadAddress}, #{xPosition}, #{yPosition}, #{placeUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl} )
